request: 16:9 output, native/monitor internal resolution, F1 options panel by area
cause_4_3: NAND had no /shared2/sys/SYSCONF; Prime's own SC library fell back to defaults (IPL.AR=0 -> 4:3). The SCGetAspectRatio HLE override sits at a Mario Kart address and never applied to Prime.
changes: wii_sysconf.h: SYSCONF writer (SCv0, offsets, typed entries, SCed). prime_host_options.cpp writes IPL.AR, IPL.SND and IPL.LNG at startup from Config.toml (video.widescreen, prime.sound_mode).
Prime widescreen presents through AURORA_VIEWPORT_16_9 (anamorphic 640x456 image shown at 16:9 with a 16:9 EFB); 4:3 uses FIT with a 4:3 lock.

Config [prime]: sound_mode, hide_cursor, gpu_thread, overlap_encode, lazy_end_drain, present_on_copy, host_audio_resampler. Exported to the existing environment switches at startup unless already set; launchers only force 0 with -SyncRenderer.

F1 panel (settings_overlay.cpp): Video (aspect, internal resolution incl. monitor-native, display mode, graphics API, copy filter, FPS), Controles (hide OS cursor, sensitivity note, key map), Audio (volume, console sound mode, host resampler, AX worker), Rendimiento (renderer options), Diagnostico.
Resolution labels clarified: 0 = monitor/window native, 1x = original Wii 640x456.

validation.log: [prime-sysconf] aspect=16:9 sound=stereo; IOS IPC open /shared2/sys/SYSCONF -> fd 4; [prime-presentation] aspect=16:9
validation.visual: hangar and strap screen fill a 16:9 rectangle with widescreen HUD and round holograms
